visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use a range input for a volume
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This volume control is a text box where the user types a number. Change it to a range slider with the same limits and the same starting value.
visualizerParams.initialCode: 50

solution.code: 50
solution.explanation: A slider is the right control for a value in a range: it needs no typing, cannot hold a wrong value, and the min and max are part of the control. The script that shows the value stays the same.

checks.label: Changing the volume updates the text
